summary.text: Alphonse Paolillo, a Democrat, was elected in 2016 to represent Connecticut House District 97 and has served since 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he was born and raised in New Haven, graduated from Wilbur Cross High School in 1990, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Connecticut in 1994.

He worked for U.S. Senator Joseph Lieberman and as a registered representative with John Hancock Financial Network, and was first elected to the 17th Ward seat on the New Haven Board of Alders in July 2003, becoming the board's majority leader in January 2012.
